newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain-Soy basis offers slip in nearbys.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain-Soy basis offers slip in nearbys.

text.p: FOB Gulf soybean basis offers slipped one cent a bushel in the nearby positions while corn and wheat values were steady.
Dealers said market conditions were quiet and most action was focused on the CBOT grains.
CBOT soybeans closed lower on a late collapse in the wheat futures, traders said.
In export news, Pakistan is seeking 200,000 tonnes of U.S. number two or better soft white wheat for November 12-30 delivery, the buyers' U.S. agent said. Bids will be opened on November 3.

Soybean and soybean meal sales to China have soared in the past few weeks. USDA figures show as of Oct 17, China had bought 442,800 tonnes of U.S. soybeans, compared to only 50,000 tonnes at this time last year, and had booked 426,000 tonnes of U.S. meal, versus nothing at this point in 1995.
